boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Rice traditions spanning matriculation, residential-college life, academic trust and spring competition.

cards.title: Beer Bike
cards.subtitle: Annual residential-college relay at Rice
cards.notes: Watch the residential colleges’ relay teams at Rice Stadium; the official format allows water chugging, while alcohol is optional only for eligible participants.
cards.short_summary: A 1957-origin bicycle relay paired with a chugging leg and college teams.
cards.evidence_claim: Rice says Beer Bike dates to 1957 and combines an intramural bicycle race with a relay-style chugging competition; water is an available chugging option.
cards.source_title: Rice’s Beer Bike brings tradition, competition and community to campus
cards.access_notes: Participate only through the event’s rules and choose the water-based option if participating; alcohol is not required.

cards.title: Willy Week
cards.subtitle: The week leading up to Beer Bike
cards.notes: Follow announced residential-college programming in the days before Beer Bike, and stick to university-approved events rather than unsanctioned pranks.
cards.short_summary: Rice’s pre–Beer Bike week of campus excitement and college activity.
cards.evidence_claim: The Association of Rice Alumni says Willy Week was coined in the 1990s for the week before Beer Bike.
cards.access_notes: Check current college and university announcements for scheduled activities.

cards.title: The Water Balloon Fight
cards.subtitle: Beer Bike day college tradition
cards.notes: Attend from designated event areas and follow staff directions; bring only event-approved water balloons and respect spectators, equipment and cleanup rules.
cards.short_summary: A large college-versus-college water-balloon event held on Beer Bike day.
cards.evidence_claim: Rice identifies the water balloon fight as a long-standing Beer Bike-day festivity between residential colleges.
cards.source_title: Rice’s Beer Bike brings tradition, competition and community to campus
cards.access_notes: Follow current event instructions and any designated participation zones.

cards.title: Color War
cards.subtitle: Beer Bike-week campus celebration
cards.notes: Look for the organized Color War during Beer Bike festivities; wear clothing you are comfortable getting colorful and follow event staff guidance.
cards.short_summary: A colorful residential-college celebration surrounding Beer Bike.
cards.evidence_claim: Rice’s 2026 Beer Bike coverage lists Color War among the campus traditions and festivities surrounding race day.
cards.source_title: Rice’s Beer Bike brings tradition, competition and community to campus
cards.access_notes: Confirm current timing and participation guidance with the relevant residential college.

cards.title: The Cheer Battle
cards.subtitle: Beer Bike day at Rice
cards.notes: Join the spectator area to hear residential-college cheers on Beer Bike day, and use the event schedule for current timing and viewing guidance.
cards.short_summary: A Beer Bike-day college cheer competition alongside the race.
cards.evidence_claim: The Association of Rice Alumni identifies the cheer battle as one of the popular events held on Beer Bike day.
cards.access_notes: Check current Beer Bike communications for the location and schedule.

cards.title: Enter Through the Sallyport
cards.subtitle: Lovett Hall’s matriculation tradition
cards.notes: New students process through Lovett Hall’s Sallyport at matriculation; photograph from permitted areas and leave the return crossing for commencement.
cards.short_summary: Rice’s ceremonial entrance through Lovett Hall at the start of a student’s university journey.
cards.evidence_claim: Rice’s O-Week schedule calls matriculation one of its oldest traditions and says each new student passes through Lovett Hall’s Sallyport.
cards.access_notes: The procession is for new students during O-Week; respect ceremonial access and pedestrian flow.

cards.title: O-Week
cards.subtitle: Rice’s new-student orientation tradition
cards.notes: Use the official O-Week schedule to find college introductions, academic sessions and community events, then attend the sessions assigned to your cohort.
cards.short_summary: A Rice orientation week that introduces incoming students to academic and residential-college life.
cards.evidence_claim: Rice describes O-Week as the period when new students meet the university community, learn about residential colleges and begin their Rice experience.
cards.access_notes: Programming is intended for incoming students; use the current official schedule for access details.

cards.title: The Honor Code Pledge
cards.subtitle: A student-enforced academic tradition
cards.notes: Read the pledge before submitting academic work and follow your instructor’s collaboration rules; ask the Honor Council when expectations are unclear.
cards.short_summary: A long-running student-enforced pledge attached to Rice academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: Rice’s historical society records that students adopted the Honor System in 1916 and signed an honor pledge at the end of examinations.
cards.access_notes: Applies within Rice academic processes; consult current Honor Council and course guidance for requirements.

cards.title: The Rice Ring
cards.subtitle: Owl-inscribed alumni ring tradition
cards.notes: View ring-design details and Rice Ring Celebration information through Alumni Relations; order only if you meet the program’s current eligibility and deadlines.
cards.short_summary: A standardized owl-inscribed ring tradition dating to Rice’s first graduating class.
cards.evidence_claim: Rice Alumni states that the Rice Ring dates to the original owl-inscribed rings of the inaugural 1916 graduating class.
cards.access_notes: Ring purchase and celebration participation are subject to current Alumni Relations eligibility and deadlines.

cards.title: Rice Blue Fridays
cards.subtitle: Weekly Rice-color tradition
cards.notes: Wear Rice colors or Rice-branded clothing on Friday if you already have it, and check campus communications for any related gathering or photo opportunity.
cards.short_summary: A newer weekly invitation for the Rice community to wear university colors or logo apparel.
cards.evidence_claim: Rice News describes Rice Blue Fridays as a new tradition encouraging students, faculty, staff, alumni and supporters to wear Rice colors or logo clothing each Friday.
cards.source_title: Watch video: Rice closes another celebration-filled academic year
cards.access_notes: No special access is indicated; participation is optional.
